assertion: A learner owns one complete local model optimizer RNG stream data cursor and fragment state vector
counterexample: A second learner aliases optimizer RNG cursor or fragment counters or resume loses adopted versions and counters
authoritative_observation: object identities serialized state and post-step events
aggregation: two learner instances plus resume round-trip
close_condition: all local mutable identities are disjoint and exact progress resumes without a distributed process group

assertion: Inner training executes without storage syncer quorum or peer-learner barriers
counterexample: A step waits on a filesystem proposal global record peer learner or collective
authoritative_observation: source call graph and slow independent data-source timing
aggregation: one learner with delayed batches and no external coordination
close_condition: the learner consumes only its independent batch source and every supplied batch reaches a bounded optimizer-step boundary

assertion: Learner local optimizer steps input tokens target tokens and each fragment counter are separate fields
counterexample: A microbatch increments a local step or any progress dimension is labeled global_step
authoritative_observation: structured event fields and serialized final summary
aggregation: all ten real steps plus gradient accumulation fixture
close_condition: exactly ten optimizer boundaries occur and distinct progress dimensions reconcile to batch masks and fragment counters

assertion: The inner LR scheduler advances explicitly by completed learner optimizer steps
counterexample: A microbatch scheduler tick or token count silently changes a local-step schedule
authoritative_observation: scheduler invocation count basis field and LR trace
close_condition: scheduler ticks equal completed optimizer steps and every event declares local_optimizer_steps as its basis

assertion: Structured telemetry records per-step latency common-interval throughput processed input tokens and explicit inactive transfer/publication fields
counterexample: Throughput is an average or sum of rank-local rates or missing transfer fields are interpreted as zero work
authoritative_observation: monotonic boundary timestamps input-token totals and applicability map
aggregation: per profile and combined inventory without synthesizing rates
close_condition: each profile throughput is total tokens divided by its own observed training interval and future S1-07/S1-08 metrics are explicitly not_exercised

assertion: Every completed update records finite token-weighted training loss and fragment-specific update norms with comparison labels
counterexample: Loss is absent NaN or detached from a parameter update or one whole-model norm is mislabeled per fragment
authoritative_observation: loss-bearing token sum parameter digest change and per-fragment squared-delta sums
aggregation: ten real steps for tiny GPT-2 and Pythia profiles
close_condition: all losses and norms are finite at least one owned parameter changes and comparison fields explicitly identify unmatched smoke evidence
